seo.title: Game Gauntlets — Random Game Picker for Steam & GOG
seo.description: Spin the wheel for a random Steam or GOG game. Filter by playtime, score and price using SteamSpy, HLTB, Metacritic and GameFAQs data.
intro.paragraph1: A one of a kind randomizer and database of all the games that existed in Steam (+GOG exclusives) with additional information about the difficulty, ratings and game length from GameFAQ, SteamSpy, HLTB, Metacritic, IGDB.
intro.paragraph2: Use the wheel on this page to find out which game you are going to play next, set your preferences on the settings page or try one of our gauntlets.
intro.paragraph3: The point of gauntlet is to experience how “diverse” the video game industry can be.
intro.list.sgg: SGG: Complete games in the specified time periods: 1985-1990, 1990-1995, 1995-2000, 2000-2003, 2003-2006, 2006-2009, 2009-2012, 2012-2014, 2014-2016, 2016-2018;
intro.list.hpg: HPG: Complete games in the specified price periods: 0-5, 5-10, 10-20, 20-30, 30-35, 35-40, 40-45, 45-50;
intro.list.speedrun: Speedrun GG: Complete 10 random games 15-25% faster than in “time to beat”;
intro.list.indie: Indie GG: Complete 10 random Indie games and support independent developers;
intro.list.coop: Coop GG: Any SGG with a filter for cooperative gameplay with an interested friend;
intro.list.oneTrick: One-trick GG: Any GG in one specific genre (only RPG, FPS, etc.);
